coder_notes: All patients must have IDH1/2-mutant glioma (WHO grade II-IV); the 'GBM Arm' and 'Recurrent Glioblastoma' condition refer to IDH-mutant grade IV glioma (historical usage), so coded not_glioblastoma per manual 1.1 note, flagged for adjudication. Temozolomide is given in every arm with a de-escalating schedule in Phase 1 to find a tolerable combination dose; coded soc_backbone (dose adaptation is for tolerability, not a TMZ schedule question) - adjudicator may consider established_therapy_experiment. MGMT and 1p/19q testing must be documented at entry but no particular status is required, so coded exploratory_correlative rather than eligibility.
